verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's corporations page links a 'Filings, Forms & Information (Download Forms)' section, so the service publishes downloadable forms. The evidence is only a navigation label, and it does not show that downloads need no account or that instructions come with the forms. The by-mail form download (docs-17) is on the Department of Revenue site, a different agency, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that downloads require no login, downloadable instructions alongside the forms, any listing of the actual forms, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
